name: Uqua: Ocean God Halls
summary: Deep ritual halls dedicated to the Ocean God, filled with water‑aligned planar conduits and Discord‑corrupted aquatic guardians.
description: The Ocean God Halls are the sacred inner chambers of Uqua, where ancient rites were performed to honor the Ocean God. Massive stone pillars rise from flooded floors, carved with depictions of tidal power and oceanic dominion. Water flows through elevated channels, defying gravity as planar energy warps its movement. Discord corruption has twisted these halls, creating unstable water anomalies and spawning aquatic manifestations. Muramite forces struggle to advance through the halls, while Ocean Cult defenders fight desperately to protect their sacred domain.
